# Adapters

Generated by `inference-docs` from the records the adapters commit. A hosted binding's claims are a claims record that a test in its adapter holds equal to the code; a local binding's claims are the capabilities its capability record gives evidence for, each evidence a named test of the adapter. Every adapter is off until you depend on it and turn on the features below. [Contracts](../concepts/contracts.md) says what each capability means.

## Environment, licences and records

What each binding reads from the environment, the licences of its code and weights or where its data goes, and the record its claims come from.

- **OpenAI Realtime**. Environment: `OPENAI_API_KEY`, or the keychain secret `openai-api-key` with feature `keychain`; `INFERENCE_OPENAI_REALTIME_MODEL`. Licences or data: hosted service: audio leaves the machine. Record: [claims-realtime.json](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/blob/main/adapters/inference-openai/records/claims-realtime.json).
- **OpenAI GPT-Live**. Environment: `OPENAI_API_KEY`, or the keychain secret `openai-api-key` with feature `keychain`. Licences or data: hosted service: audio leaves the machine; billed per session second. Record: [claims-gpt-live.json](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/blob/main/adapters/inference-openai/records/claims-gpt-live.json).
- **Amazon Nova Sonic on Bedrock**. Environment: the AWS default credential chain; `AWS_REGION`; `INFERENCE_NOVA_SONIC_MODEL`. Licences or data: hosted service: audio leaves the machine. Record: [claims-nova-sonic.json](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/blob/main/adapters/inference-aws/records/claims-nova-sonic.json).
- **sherpa-onnx streaming STT**. Environment: `INFERENCE_SHERPA_ONNX_STT_DIR`. Licences or data: code Apache-2.0 (sherpa-onnx 1.13.8), MIT (onnxruntime); weights Apache-2.0, trained on LibriSpeech (CC BY 4.0). Record: [stt-i9-10900k-cpu.json](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/blob/main/adapters/inference-sherpa-onnx/records/stt-i9-10900k-cpu.json).
- **whisper.cpp batch STT**. Environment: `INFERENCE_WHISPERCPP_STT_MODEL`. Licences or data: code MIT (whisper.cpp), Unlicense (whisper-rs); weights MIT. Record: [stt-i9-10900k-cpu.json](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/blob/main/adapters/inference-whispercpp/records/stt-i9-10900k-cpu.json).
- **llama-server LLM**. Environment: `INFERENCE_LLAMA_SERVER_URL`, `INFERENCE_LLAMA_SERVER_MODEL`. Licences or data: code MIT (llama.cpp); weights Apache-2.0. Record: [reference-machine-cpu.json](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/blob/main/adapters/inference-llama-server/capability/reference-machine-cpu.json).
- **llama-server LLM, tools on**. Environment: `INFERENCE_LLAMA_SERVER_URL`, `INFERENCE_LLAMA_SERVER_MODEL`. Licences or data: code MIT (llama.cpp); weights Apache-2.0. Record: [reference-machine-cpu-tools.json](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/blob/main/adapters/inference-llama-server/capability/reference-machine-cpu-tools.json).

## Claims

Every capability of the contract and the bindings that claim it, separated by semicolons. A capability nobody claims is still part of the contract: a pipeline that requires it is refused at planning, naming the node.

| Capability | Claimed by |
|---|---|
| `output_streaming` | OpenAI Realtime; OpenAI GPT-Live; Amazon Nova Sonic on Bedrock; sherpa-onnx streaming STT; llama-server LLM; llama-server LLM, tools on |
| `incremental_input` | OpenAI Realtime; OpenAI GPT-Live; Amazon Nova Sonic on Bedrock; sherpa-onnx streaming STT |
| `concurrent_input_output` | OpenAI Realtime; OpenAI GPT-Live; Amazon Nova Sonic on Bedrock |
| `native_duplex` | OpenAI GPT-Live |
| `revisable_input` | none |
| `tool_calling` | OpenAI Realtime; OpenAI GPT-Live; Amazon Nova Sonic on Bedrock; llama-server LLM, tools on |
| `interruptible` | OpenAI Realtime; Amazon Nova Sonic on Bedrock |
| `resumable_model_state` | none |
| `audio_text_alignment` | none |
| `orchestrated_duplex` | none |
